question: Identify the top 3 German drivers born between 1980 and 1985 who achieved the fastest average lap time during lap 1 across all races held at circuits in Spain, and return their full names ordered by this average lap time.

SELECT T1."XCL_038", T1."XCL_039"
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_044"
INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2."XCL_043" = T3."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T3."XCL_068" = T4."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
  AND T4."XCL_005" = 'Spain'
  AND T2."XCL_045" = 1
GROUP BY T1."XCL_038", T1."XCL_039"
ORDER BY AVG(T2."XCL_048") ASC
LIMIT 3
